calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  d.fiscal_week_start_date,
  d.fiscal_week_end_date,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
)
SELECT 
  current_year.fiscal_week,
  current_year.fiscal_week_start_date,
  current_year.fiscal_week_end_date,
  ROUND(current_year.net_sales, 2) as net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(prior_year.net_sales, 2) as net_sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(((current_year.net_sales - prior_year.net_sales) / prior_year.net_sales) * 100, 2) as growth_pct
FROM weekly_sales current_year
INNER JOIN weekly_sales prior_year 
  ON current_year.fiscal_week = prior_year.fiscal_week 
  AND current_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND prior_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
ORDER BY current_year.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_week,
  COUNT(DISTINCT d.calendar_date) as trading_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) as days_with_sales
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC, d.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  business_date,
  SUM(net_sales) as daily_total
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2025-05-26' AND '2025-06-22'
GROUP BY business_date
ORDER BY business_date

WITH weekly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_week,
    d.fiscal_week_start_date,
    d.fiscal_week_end_date,
    SUM(rpt.net_sales) as net_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
    AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
)
SELECT 
  current_year.fiscal_week,
  current_year.fiscal_week_start_date,
  current_year.fiscal_week_end_date,
  ROUND(current_year.net_sales, 2) as net_sales_fy2025_26,
  ROUND(prior_year.net_sales, 2) as net_sales_fy2024_25,
  ROUND(((current_year.net_sales - prior_year.net_sales) / prior_year.net_sales) * 100, 2) as growth_pct
FROM weekly_sales current_year
INNER JOIN weekly_sales prior_year 
  ON current_year.fiscal_week = prior_year.fiscal_week 
  AND current_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND prior_year.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
ORDER BY current_year.fiscal_week

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  SUM(rpt.net_sales) as total_net_sales,
  SUM(rpt.returns_net) as total_returns,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rpt.business_date) as days_recorded,
  COUNT(DISTINCT rpt.store_id) as stores
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
  AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
ORDER BY d.fiscal_year DESC

SELECT DISTINCT
  CASE WHEN fy25_26.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN fy25_26.store_id ELSE fy24_25.store_id END as store_id,
  CASE WHEN fy25_26.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Present in FY2025/26' ELSE 'Only in FY2024/25' END as fiscal_year_presence,
  CASE WHEN fy24_25.store_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Present in FY2024/25' ELSE 'Only in FY2025/26' END as fy2024_25_presence
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
) fy25_26
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM rpt_daily_store_sales rpt
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON rpt.business_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_week IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
) fy24_25 ON fy25_26.store_id = fy24_25.store_id
WHERE fy25_26.store_id IS NULL OR fy24_25.store_id IS NULL
ORDER BY store_id
